name: a6fdvd-u1-verification-chip
goal: U1 verification chip: a missing verification is a muted outlined 'Not verified' chip with no icon; red with a cross only for a failed verification; green check for passed. Applies to the catalog card and entity header. Source: packages/reports/src/components/shared-primitives/status/Status.svelte. Test: a card with no verification shows the text 'Not verified' and no element painted in the danger colour.

evidence: The verification chip needs to show a muted Not verified label when no verification exists. The error color is reserved for failures.
The old shell fixture did not check the unrecorded chip at phone, tablet and laptop sizes. The committed verification-chip spec checks its label, icon, border, and colors at those sizes.
The Chromium replay of the committed verification-chip spec at af093edbb9 failed at all three sizes on the Not verified text assertion.
The existing U1 fix cc79d4cd0c renders the unrecorded status as a muted chip.
